jobs.title: Maintenance Tool Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. About the Service Tooling & Processes Team Our team’s brief is to make maintenance better across Zipline. From designing smart fixtures that allow us to interact with our aircraft electronically to writing and validating maintenance procedures to kitting mobile maintenance vans that allow technicians to service our system in the summer heat, we aim to improve every aspect of maintenance. Our direct customers are the operational maintenance teams working on our systems in the field, and we’re laser-focused on making their lives better. If a maintenance technician working at 2 in the morning has everything they need to complete their work quickly, efficiently, and reliably, then we’ve done our job well. The Role As Zipline continues to rapidly iterate our hardware, we need to design, validate, and field new tools to allow technicians to do their work safely and efficiently. You’ll work closely with maintenance to understand their needs and pain points, then partner with hardware and tooling engineers to create solutions. Our team is based out of a high-volume test facility, so you’ll see your designs get immediate use, immediate feedback, and plenty of iteration cycles. Once those tools have been perfected at our test facilities they become part of our operational toolkits across all of Zipline and make real, tangible impacts on how we serve our customers. What You'll Do Work closely with Hardware and Operations teams to understand pain points and process requirements. Design and prototype tools for drone and ground system maintenance. Use hand and machine tools to produce the first units. Gather operational feedback on your designs and iterate quickly. Partner with Operations leadership on trade studies to evaluate the optimal, fully-productionized forms of your design. Create usage documentation and lead training sessions as your designs roll out into operation. What You'll Bring A strong grasp of mechanical design fundamentals (statics, dynamics, material properties, fabrication processes, etc). Proficiency with CAD software like NX, Solidworks, Fusion, etc. Hands-on prototyping experience like 3d printing, fabrications, welding, soldering, or assembly. Strong communication skills and an ability to collaborate cross-functionally. Obsessive customer focus and a drive to understand how your designs work in the real world. Ability to work on-site at our test facility in Esparto, CA every day. What Else You Should Know This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our Esparto, CA Office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns from this summer (May/June - August/September). Zipline is unable to sponsor work visas for applicants to this position. The hourly rate for this internship is $37 per hour. Additional benefits may include relocation support, a housing stipend, overtime pay, paid sick time, and other benefits, where applicable and subject to local requirements. Candidates are limited to three (3) applications within a 30-day period. Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your point of contact at Zipline know if you require any accommodations throughout your interview process. Voluntary Self-Identification For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file. As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

jobs.title: Nuclear Engineering Internship/Co-op
jobs.body: FORGE ATOMICS Humanity faces two critical challenges: securing reliable energy and aggressively lowering our environmental impact. At Forge, we believe nuclear fission is the key to solving both at once. Today Forge is developing the technology to rapidly scale the deployment of nuclear fission. NUCLEAR ENGINEERING INTERNSHIP/CO-OP As a nuclear engineering intern at Forge, you'll contribute directly to the nuclear design and safety analysis of our first reactor, Ember — core design and fuel cycle, reactivity control, and radiation release and dose analysis. You'll work inside our simulation and analysis toolchain alongside the engineers carrying the design from today's working models toward licensing and first criticality, and your analyses will feed real design decisions. Internship and co-op positions are available for the Summer 2027 and Fall 2027 terms; you'll indicate which term(s) you're available for when you apply. Responsibilities - Own a well-scoped nuclear analysis end-to-end — criticality, depletion, reactivity coefficients, shielding — with the mentorship of the engineer responsible for that area - Run and extend reactor physics simulations supporting core design, fuel cycle, and reactivity control studies - Support radiation shielding and release analysis against regulatory limits - Build and improve the analysis tools and automation that let a small team move at unprecedented speed - Collaborate daily with fluids, structures, components, and manufacturing engineers to keep the design system-optimized and manufacturable Basic Qualifications - Must be enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in an engineering, physics or math discipline by the start of employment - 3+ months of applied engineering experience (internships and project team experience (i.e. FSAE, Rocketry, Cube Sat, Solar Car) are strongly preferred) - Must be able to comply with U.S. Department of Energy export control regulations governing access to nuclear technology (10 CFR Part 810). U.S. citizenship is not required: Forge can generally host citizens of generally authorized countries (including Canada, the U.K., E.U. member states, Japan, and South Korea), and supports J-1 exchange visitor sponsorship for international students Preferred Skills and Experience - GPA of 3.5 or above - 12+ months experience of application of technical skills outside of the classroom. Prior internships and project team experience are strongly preferred. Exceptional personal projects or laboratory research can serve as substitutes. - Ability to work well in an integrated collaborative team environment, including frequent interactions with technicians, other engineers, and managers - Ability to work effectively in a dynamic professional setting with changing needs and requirements - Coursework or research in reactor physics, radiation transport, thermal hydraulics, or health physics - Experience with reactor physics or radiation transport codes (e.g. OpenMC, MCNP, Serpent) and scientific computing in Python Additional Requirements - Position will be based in the South Bay area of Los Angeles County and will require relocation if not already local. The position will be full-time in the office for the duration of the internship/co-op term. - Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary Compensation and Benefits Pay range: - Engineering Intern/Freshman/Sophomore: $28.00/hour - Engineering Intern/Junior/Senior: $30.00/hour Your actual level and hourly rate will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Interns accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law, and receive access to various other perks. Forge is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Forge is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant's capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

jobs.title: Intern - DRAM Design Engineer
jobs.body: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. At Micron, the DRAM Design organization develops industry-leading memory solutions that span technology development, advanced circuit design, product engineering, system validation, and manufacturing enablement. Teams collaborate globally to deliver innovative memory products that meet demanding requirements for performance, quality, reliability, and time-to-market. As an Intern DRAM Design Engineer, you will contribute to the design, analysis, verification, and optimization of digital, analog, and mixed-signal circuits used in next-generation memory products. You will work closely with design, verification, product engineering, test, process integration, assembly, and marketing teams to support new product development and manufacturability initiatives. This role also provides opportunities to apply Artificial Intelligence and AI Assisted methodologies to improve design workflows, automation, and design quality. Responsibilities Play a key role in the development of new memory products through circuit build, layout, optimization, and validation of Memory, Logic, and Analog circuits. Support physical design activities including parasitic modeling, floor-planning, placement, routing, reticle experiments, tape-out revisions, and design verification using industry-standard simulation tools. Collaborate with global design, verification, product engineering, test, process integration, assembly, and marketing teams to improve manufacturability, quality, and product performance. Proactively engage with CAD, modeling, standards, and verification teams to improve design methodologies and overall design quality. Develop AI Assisted software tools and leverage Artificial Intelligence to enhance design methodologies, workflow automation, engineering productivity, and design quality. Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering. Must be continuing academic studies through at least Fall 2027 and not graduate before Fall 2027. Coursework, academic projects, or research experience in digital design, analog design, semiconductor devices, VLSI, computer architecture, or related areas. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively both independently and within team environments. Experience preparing and presenting technical findings through reports, presentations, or project evaluations. Preferred Qualifications Experience with circuit simulation, verification, modeling, or industry-standard EDA tools. Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing, memory architecture, DRAM design concepts, or integrated circuit development. Familiarity with physical design concepts including floor-planning, placement, routing, parasitic extraction, or layout optimization. Experience Applying AI, Using AI, or Leveraging Artificial Intelligence to improve engineering workflows, automation, software development, or technical analysis. Exposure to AI Assisted tools, Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, or AI-Enabled software solutions for engineering productivity and design optimization. As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits . Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
